title: Deploy only verified/master, from its own workflow

story.i_want_to: have production deploy exactly the commit verified/master names, once, and never a master tip the verifier has not passed
story.so_that: what runs on loopctl.com is always a commit the whole CI run passed on

rationale: ci.yml's deploy job needs lint, test, security, dialyzer, pgbouncer-e2e, retrieval-eval and smoke-preflight and deploys the pushed master commit (.github/workflows/ci.yml:1705-1729). It deploys before any verifier has spoken and once per push, and it records no GitHub deployment, so post-deploy verification, which reads the production environment's deployments by sha (lib/loopctl/delivery/post_deploy_verification.ex:35-43, :189), has nothing of loopctl's own to read. chg's rule is that a deploy runs only from a sha equal to verified/master (chg/docs/verify.md:79-83, design.md:421).

acceptance_criteria.description: .github/workflows/deploy.yml (name: Deploy) triggers on workflow_run of workflow `Verify master` with types [completed] and branches [master], plus workflow_dispatch; job deploy runs on ubuntu-latest with concurrency group deploy and cancel-in-progress false.

.github/scripts/deploy-verified.sh reads the sha of refs/heads/verified/master from the GitHub API at run time, never github.event.workflow_run.head_sha, and checks that exact sha out before building.
When verified/master does not exist the script prints `::warning::no verified/master ref to deploy; the next green master run creates it` and exits 0 without calling flyctl deploy.

When `flyctl image show -a loopctl --json` reports the running image tag `verified-<sha>` for the verified sha, the script prints `production already runs verified/master <sha>; nothing to deploy` and exits 0 without deploying.
Otherwise the script runs scripts/smoke.sh against the live release first, and a failed preflight stops the deploy with exit 1, as ci.yml's smoke-preflight gates it today (ci.yml:1669-1703).

The deploy runs `flyctl deploy --remote-only --image-label verified-<sha>` and records a GitHub deployment in environment production whose sha is the verified sha, with status success on exit 0 and failure otherwise.

ci.yml no longer has a deploy or smoke job; deploy.yml's smoke job runs scripts/smoke.sh with SMOKE_CONTEXT=post-deploy after deploy succeeded, gates nothing, and keeps the advisory name `Post-deploy Smoke (advisory — release already shipped)`.

The Verify master run of an older sha that completes after a newer one deploys nothing older: the script deploys the ref's current sha, which only moves forward, so a second run for the same ref is the no-op of AC-53.2.4.

test_cases.name: guard: Deploy's triggers, runner and concurrency; ci.yml has no deploy or smoke (ExUnit over the parsed workflows)
expected_results: workflow_run of ["Verify master"], completed, [master]; workflow_dispatch present; runs-on ubuntu-latest; group deploy, cancel-in-progress false
smoke needs deploy, its if requires needs.deploy.result == 'success', its env sets SMOKE_CONTEXT post-deploy
ci.yml jobs contain neither deploy nor smoke

test_cases.name: script: deploys the ref's sha with its label and records the deployment (stub gh, git, flyctl, smoke)
preconditions: @tag :tmp_dir; stub gh answering git/ref/heads/verified/master with sha B and logging deployment POSTs; GITHUB_EVENT carrying workflow_run.head_sha A != B; stub flyctl whose image show reports tag verified-A; stub smoke.sh exiting 0
expected_results: git checkout of B, never A
one deployment created with environment production and sha B, then a success status

test_cases.name: script: no ref, and an already-running sha, deploy nothing
steps: run with gh answering 404 for the ref
run with flyctl image show reporting verified-B
run twice in a row with the second image show reporting verified-B
expected_results: each no-deploy run exits 0 with its exact message and the flyctl log has no deploy call
the double run deploys B exactly once

test_cases.name: script: a red preflight smoke stops the deploy
expected_results: exit 1, no flyctl deploy call, no deployment created

test_cases.name: script: a failed flyctl deploy marks the deployment failed
preconditions: as TC-53.2.2, stub flyctl deploy exiting 1
expected_results: exit 1 and the deployment's last status is failure

technical_notes: Moved, with their comments: the deploy job (ci.yml:1705-1729, flyctl at :1726-1727) and the smoke job (ci.yml:1731-1798). smoke-preflight (ci.yml:1669-1703) stays in ci.yml as an area-gate need (ci.yml:1810); the deploy script runs the same scripts/smoke.sh again immediately before it ships, because a verified sha may deploy long after its CI run.

Hosted, not fleet-ci: the reasons at ci.yml:83-92 (deploy credentials stay off the self-hosted pool) carry over. FLY_API_TOKEN and LOOPCTL_SMOKE_KEY are existing repository secrets (gh secret list, 2026-11-20).
Three workflow_run levels (CI -> Verify master -> Deploy) is the most GitHub chains; HCB's deploy.yml says the same (HCB .github/workflows/deploy.yml:27). Nothing may be chained after Deploy.

Never the workflow run's head_sha: the reason is in lib/loopctl/delivery/post_deploy_verification.ex:35-43 (KB 3670a0de): a workflow_run run is attributed to the branch head at creation. The deployment record's sha is what that module compares, environment default production (:189, :305-313).

flyctl deploy --image-label and flyctl image show --json exist (flyctl --help, 2026-11-20). The JSON field that carries the tag is UNGROUNDED: confirm it against a live `flyctl image show -a loopctl --json` before writing the parser, and fail the run (never deploy blind) when the field is absent.

Readers of the moved jobs: test/loopctl/factory_ci_workflows_test.exs:23-26 (@not_on_push names deploy and smoke) and :310-323 (deploy and smoke conditions) move to deploy_workflow_test.exs; docs/runbooks/post-deploy-smoke.md:111-122 and :231-258 and scripts/smoke.sh:8 name ci.yml's smoke job and are repointed to deploy.yml.

CHANGELOG.md: deploy ordering changed (operator-facing). docs/runbooks/chg-flow.md gains a `Deploy` section: how to redeploy verified/master by hand (gh workflow run deploy.yml) and why a merge alone no longer deploys.
Fly app name loopctl (fly.toml:4); release_command /app/bin/migrate (fly.toml:27) still runs inside flyctl deploy, so migration ordering is unchanged.
non_goals: Automatic rollback on a red post-deploy smoke (chg design.md:185): the smoke stays advisory, as ci.yml has it today.
Gating factory-release.yml (factory-release.yml:14-30) on verified/master: an owner question in the epic report.
Moving deploy onto fleet-ci: excluded by ci.yml:83-92.

failure_modes.partition: AC-53.2.6: Fly unreachable fails flyctl deploy, the deployment is marked failure and verified/master is untouched, so the next Deploy run ships it.
failure_modes.state: AC-53.2.4: what production runs is read from Fly's image tag, the one record of it; the GitHub deployment mirrors the sha for post-deploy verification.
failure_modes.retry: AC-53.2.8: a re-run or a late older run reads the current ref and meets the running-label no-op, so nothing deploys twice or backwards.
failure_modes.slow: AC-53.2.1: concurrency group deploy keeps one deploy at a time with one pending run, which a newer completion replaces, so a slow Fly build coalesces a burst into one deploy of the newest verified sha.
failure_modes.reach: AC-53.2.2: the job finds what to ship by reading verified/master from GitHub, wherever the run lands.

definition_of_done: After the merge, the next green master commit produces CI -> Verify master -> Deploy runs for the same sha, and `flyctl image show -a loopctl` reports tag verified-<that sha>.
A manual `gh workflow run deploy.yml` right after prints the nothing-to-deploy line and creates no deployment.
defaults: Image label verified-<40-hex sha> (owner may change).
GitHub deployment environment production, matching post-deploy verification's default.
Pre-deploy smoke runs in the deploy job, in addition to ci.yml's smoke-preflight.
